context: The RISC-V privileged specification's unprivileged CSR listing covers floating-point registers (fflags, frm, fcsr), vector registers (vstart, vxsat, vxrm, vcsr, vl, vtype, vlenb), Zicfiss shadow stack pointer, entropy source seed, Zcmt jump vector table, and unprivileged counters and timers including cycle, time, instret, and hpmcounters with RV32 upper-32-bit variants.
